page.overview:
Who is K'thugguol?

K'thugguol, a.k.a. the Slime-Thing or the Grand Shoggoth, is a fictional character created by Lin Carter for his short story "The Descent into the Abyss". It is the oldest and mightiest member of the shoggoth species, the first of its kind to have been created, and a servant of the entity Ubbo-Sathla, who the shoggoths adopted as their god.

Like a typical shoggoth, K'thugguol is described as a large, gelatinous, amoeboid creature with myriads of eyestalks. It dwells deep in the subterranean realm of grey-litten Y'qaa and guards the entrance of the pit inhabited by Ubbo-Sathla. Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Other Supernatural Beings
